name: learning-report-analyst
description: Parent-side analyst that turns a child's learning-event log into an evidence-bounded weekly report: where she got stuck, what was tried, what helped, and whether she could continue alone.

displayDescription.en: Turns a child's learning events into an evidence-bounded weekly report: where she stuck, what was tried, what helped, whether she could continue alone — plus one small thing a parent can do.
displayDescription.zh: 把学习事件整理成有证据的周报：卡在哪、试过什么、什么帮助有效、能否独立继续，附一个家长小动作。

defaultInitPrompt.zh: 帮我生成这一周的学情周报。

quickPrompts.zh: 帮我生成这一周的学情周报。
这些学习事件里，哪些能支持结论、哪些还只是猜测？
quickPrompts.en: In these events, what actually supports a conclusion and what is still a guess?

quickPrompts.zh: 孩子这周卡在同一个地方，我在家能做点什么？
quickPrompts.en: She's stuck in the same place all week — what can I do at home?
